store.tagline: Slide the basket, catch the falling stars, dodge the bombs — and survive as the sky speeds up.
store.how_it_plays: Golden stars and red bombs rain from the top of the screen. Move your basket to catch every star (+1) while dodging the bombs — and don't let a star hit the floor. You start with three hearts; catch a bomb or miss a star and you lose one. The stars fall faster and thicker the longer you last, so it's you against your own best score.

features.title: One-more-go arcade loop
features.body: A tight catch-and-dodge game that ramps up until it beats you — then dares you to try again.

features.title: Play it your way
features.body: Arrow keys, A / D, mouse-drag or touch all steer the basket.

features.title: Rising difficulty
features.body: Stars fall faster and bombs get more common the longer you survive.

features.title: Beat your best
features.body: Your top score is saved locally and shown right in the HUD.

includes: YouTeacher Activator — one app licenses every game on your USB

setup.title: Install & activate
setup.body: Run the installer and license it with your USB via the YouTeacher Activator.

setup.title: Press Play
setup.body: Hit Play and start catching stars — no account, no internet needed.

setup.title: Chase the high score
setup.body: Survive the speed-up and push your best score higher each run.
